profile_text.body:
ALLIENT INC is listed as a for-profit public company with the ticker ALNT and CIK 0000046129, headquartered in Williamsville, New York. The website associated with the entry, alantra.com, describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. According to that site text, it provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and it describes its listed partnership model as combining corporate governance structures with team autonomy and personal investment in the firm.

No AI products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are recorded. Its recorded law exposure is in New York, with a count of 458, and no individual cases are listed.
